newsitem.title: UK: Porsche puts 34,000 stg price tag on Boxster in UK.
newsitem.headline: Porsche puts 34,000 stg price tag on Boxster in UK.

text.p: Porsche AG said on Tuesday that its new Boxster sports car will be sold in Britain for 33,950 stg, including delivery charges.
The Boxster, the result of Porsche's decision to broaden its customer base with a less expensive model, was launched at the Paris Motor Show earlier this month.
Porsche chairman Wendelin Wiedeking told reporters at the British International Motor Show that "market conditions have never been so good as they are today."
He added that the Boxster was being launched "at a time when the British market is going from strength to strength."
The Boxster's price tag is sharply lower than the 62,000-97,000 stg retail price of Porsche's flagship 911 sportscar, and is aimed at rivalling the Mercedes SLK model and BMW's Z3 roadster.

Adrian Hallmark, who becomes managing director of Porsche Cars' UK operations later this month, said Porsche expects to sell more 911 models internationally this year "than at any time in its history."
Production of 911s at the group's Stuttgart plant has already passed the 20,000 mark this year, putting it on target for a record-breaking year.
911 sales in Britain are expected to total 1,420 in 1996.
Hallmark said the company had received 550 British orders for the Boxster, with the first right-hand drive models on British roads in December.
A Porsche spokesman said the company's aim is to shift production in Stuttgart to a 50/50 split between the Boxster and 911 models, representing annual sales of 15,000 for each car.
